# Arte da missão unificada

Gerada com o ImageGen integrado. Arquivos usados pelo jogo:

- `title-pixel-v27.png`: tela inicial, paisagem clara em pixel art.
- `village-boy-v27.png`: NPC transparente, poses de pedido de socorro e agradecimento.
- O HUD mantém `dragon-hud-v26.png` e a fonte local VT323, com o tema complementar `journey-pixel.css`.

## Prompt da tela inicial

Production game title screen background, wide 16:9 landscape. Dragon Ball early Saiyan saga, authentic crisp 16-bit PIXEL ART built from visible square pixel clusters and a limited bright palette, not painted anime or a smooth illustration. Sunlit tropical coast, turquoise sea, Kame House small on a distant island, golden Nimbus clouds, rolling green hills and rocky mountains, a faint white capsule trail in the blue sky. On the RIGHT HALF: recognizable adult Goku in orange gi and blue undershirt in front, Piccolo in purple gi standing a little behind, young Gohan with red cap peeking between them. Friendly adventure mood with a distant small Raditz silhouette atop a far rocky ridge. LEFT 45 PERCENT has pale open sky and simple quiet sea, generously empty for readable live title and menu buttons. A small four-star Dragon Ball glints in foreground at lower right. Match an ivory, cobalt blue, emerald and golden orange pixel HUD. Strong pixel silhouettes, stepped pixel edges, restrained 3-tone shading, no blur, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermarks, no UI baked into the image.

## Prompt do menino

Transparent PNG pixel art sprite sheet for a light Dragon Ball inspired adventure. Two separate full body sprites side by side, equal cells, generous transparent space. An ordinary village boy about eight years old, clearly NOT Gohan: short brown hair, teal tunic, cream shorts, brown shoes, no cap, no Dragon Ball, no tail. Left sprite: frightened standing, both arms raised calling for help. Right sprite: relieved smile, one arm waving thanks. Both facing LEFT, same scale and consistent proportions, feet on matching baseline. Crisp visible 16-bit pixel clusters, small readable face, 3-tone shading, cobalt outlines, limited saturated cheerful palette. No text, no shadows, no background, no gradients. Runtime NPC asset, not a mockup.
